message: Fulham Broadway: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the eastbound platform due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

LIVERPOOL STREET NATIONAL RAIL STATION: From Sunday 22 November until mid-February the lift between the NR concourse and Tube ticket hall (for step-free access to the Elizabeth line and the eastbound Circle and Hammersmith & City lines) will be out of service for replacement work. For step-free access to enter Liverpool Street, an alternative lift is available in the Broadgate shops which will take you to street level and step-free entry to the station is available via the Broadgate entrance

CANADA WATER STATION: Until Spring 2027, no step-free access between street and ticket hall level at this station. This is while we carry out lift replacement work. For step-free access to the Jubilee line, take bus 47 or 188 from stop B1 in the bus station to Bermondsey. For step-free access to the Windrush line, take any bus from stop B2, or bus 1 or 381 from stop C in the bus station to Surrey Quays. Alternatively, it is about an 800m journey to Surrey Quays at street level via Deal Porters Way. You will not be able to use the lift between the street and ticket hall to enter the station. Please plan ahead and allow more time for your journey
